title: Kabir Smoke Script
features:
A highly optimized, seamless visual execution script featuring an all-new Natural Fluid Dispersion Engine. No clunky instant-deletes—when the system toggles off, the smoke naturally drifts, fades, and dissolves into the atmosphere.

🔥 KEY FEATURES:

Natural Particle Fade: Smoke simulation utilizes realistic decay and rate damping on toggle-off.

Detachable Mini-Toggle: Need to clean up your screen? Press the anchor icon to spawn a sleek, draggable, fully-synchronized mini-button and hide the main dashboard.

Textless Interface: Zero screen-cluttering text effects. Pure, streamlined visual performance.

Cinematic Timeline Mode: Includes an optional high-octane 70-second countdown with custom audio mapping, camera shakes, and screen distortions.
